feeds.title: Cancer Research UK
feeds.description: Cancer Research UK is the world's leading independent charity dedicated to cancer research. We carry out scientific research to help prevent, diagnose and treat cancer. We have discovered new ways to beat cancer that together have saved hundreds of thousands of lives across the world.

feeds.title: American Association for Cancer Research Blog
feeds.description: Cancer Research Catalyst is the official blog of the American Association for Cancer Research. Subscribe now to be notified when the latest cancer blog posts are published.

feeds.title: World Cancer Research Fund Blog
feeds.description: World Cancer Research Fund International leads and unifies a network of cancer charities with a global reach, dedicated to the prevention of cancer through diet, weight and physical activity. Our blog sharing lifestyle tips, news and supporter stories.

feeds.title: The Mark Foundation for Cancer Research Blog
feeds.description: The Mark Foundation for Cancer Research Blog is the official blog of The Mark Foundation for Cancer Research, a non-profit organization dedicated to advancing cancer research and developing new treatments for cancer patients. The blog provides information on the latest research findings, updates on ongoing research projects, and insights into the challenges and opportunities in cancer research

feeds.title: Children's Cancer Research Fund Blog
feeds.description: Children's Cancer Research Fund invests in lifesaving, leading-edge research in the prevention, diagnosis, treatment, and cure of childhood cancers and blood-related disorders.

feeds.title: Manchester Cancer Research Centre Blog Archives
feeds.description: All latest articles from Manchester Cancer Research Centre Blog Archives.

feeds.title: NFCR Blog
feeds.description: Blog topics cover cancer awareness, cancer-fighting lifestyle and food, cancer prevention, cancer research breakthroughs, and stories that inspire. The National Foundation for Cancer Research (NFCR) is dedicated to providing scientists in the lab the funding they need to make life-saving discoveries.

feeds.title: CureSearch Blog
feeds.description: The CureSearch blog is about children's cancer survivors, fighters and supporters, and the cancer research that accelerates the search for cures.

feeds.title: Saint John's Cancer Institute Blog
feeds.description: Saint John's Cancer Institute is a cancer research institute dedicated to the understanding and curing of cancer. Key topics covered are brain tumor, gynecologic, cancer awareness, research, and melanoma.

feeds.title: Cancer Research Institute Blog
feeds.description: Founded in 1953, CRI is the world's leading nonprofit dedicated to funding cancer. The Cancer Research Institute Blog provides insights into the latest developments in cancer immunotherapy research, news on new treatment options, and patient stories. The articles on this blog cover a range of topics related to cancer immunotherapy, including the latest clinical trials, new drugs and therapies, and emerging technologies.

feeds.title: EACR
feeds.description: The Cancer Researcher is an online-only magazine for the cancer research community from the European Association for Cancer Research (EACR). We publish inspiring and insightful content on topics that are of interest to cancer researchers across the world. We aim to engage, inspire and inform. Summaries of the latest research news, practical tips, light-hearted tales of experiments gone wrong, advice from top scientists we'll publish whatever researchers want to read.

feeds.title: Cancer Research Malaysia
feeds.description: We are Cancer Research Malaysia. We are committed to an understanding of cancer prevention, diagnosis and treatment through a fundamental research program. Stories Inspired by patients, funded by donations Keep an eye out for our latest updates and informative articles. Powered by Asian genomics Keep an eye out for our latest updates and informative articles.

feeds.title: Breakthrough Cancer Research Blog
feeds.description: Breakthrough Cancer Research funds the development of new treatment options for poor prognosis & incurable cancers. Their blog section explores subjects like cancer prevention, cancer myths, explore scientific concepts, and new avenues they are pursuing in research but all with a focus on cancer.

feeds.title: The Institute of Cancer Research
feeds.description: The Institute of Cancer Research, London, is one of the world's most influential cancer research organisations, with an outstanding record of achievement. Their mission is to make the discoveries that defeat cancer.

feeds.title: American Institute for Cancer Research Blog
feeds.description: Blog posts contain information on how to persevere when experiencing the long-term effects of cancer as well as healthy lifestyle choices. The American Institute for Cancer Research funds cutting-edge research to help prevent and survive cancer.
